item.title: Matthew's Hope hosts karaoke during emergency shelter
item.description: MissingLink Entertainment brought its karaoke machine Sunday, Feb. 1, to entertain the homeless.

item.title: Oakland commissioners approve $55 million on-site sewage treatment plan
item.description: The plan for remediation is required by the state. Oakland’s plans will take place over the next two decades.

item.title: Boys & Girls Club to open Winter Garden branch in August
item.description: After two years of construction, the Boys & Girls Club’s new branch will open in August at 459 Ninth St., Winter Garden.

item.title: Horizon West teen with cancer inspires 5K
item.description: Savannah Emery's acute myeloid leukemia diagnosis and treatments have sparked a desire for her family to help children just like her.

item.title: West Orange Dream Center welcomes new executive director
item.description: Julia Martinez had prayed for a decade to return to doing what she loved.

item.title: The City of Ocoee opens its 21st Annual Black History Month Essay Contest
item.description: The essay contest is open to fifth-grade students at schools in Ocoee.

item.title: Orange County Mayor debates suing federal government
item.description: Jerry Demings said the federal government is putting a burden on local governments by failing to adequately compensate them for costs associated with housing ICE detainees.

item.title: Two Bridges Pub & Eatery closes unexpectedly
item.description: The spot located at 16112 Marsh Road, Winter Garden, opened for the last time Tuesday, Feb. 3, and unexpectedly closed its doors.

item.title: Windermere Lakes Cleanup Day postponed
item.description: Lakes Cleanup Day, originally scheduled for Sunday, Feb. 8, was postponed due to inclement weather and low registration.

item.title: CFS Coffee is coming to Horizon West
item.description: The coffee shop will be opening at the new Shoppes at Lakeview Pointe.
